CardDose.title: CardDose
CardDose.description:
A regimen as the user recorded it from the doctor's instructions. A `schedule.type` of
"prn" means as needed: the app must say so, not show it as a fixed dose.

Elapsed.title: Elapsed
Elapsed.description:
Time since the transplant, never more than can be true (counted from the last possible
day of a month/year-only date); `approximate`: show "≈" or the year, not a day count.

RegimenIn.title: RegimenIn
RegimenIn.description:
A dose and schedule from `effective_from` on, as the doctor instructed.

daily/weekly: amounts per time (`schedule.times[].amount`, e.g. 2 mg at 08:00 and 1.5 mg
at 20:00) with one `dose_unit`, or no amounts at all. prn: `dose_amount` + `dose_unit`
(or neither). `dose_unit` "other" needs `dose_unit_text`.

SummaryOut.title: SummaryOut
SummaryOut.description: Counts only: no "on time" threshold, no colour, no judgement (Q23, rule 10).

device_token.title: Device Token
device_token.description: Returned once when this device becomes trusted; store securely.

VitalsIn.title: VitalsIn
VitalsIn.description:
One reading: a single kind, or blood pressure (systolic + diastolic, pulse optional)
measured together.
